title: Storm Coming!
description: The sky changes suddenly, and strong winds roll up giant waves. A pitch-black cumulonimbus cloud is rapidly enveloping this sea area. The ship is tossing violently in the waves, you must make a decision immediately.

choices.label: Full speed ahead: Maintain speed and force through the storm.
Slow down: Reduce speed to 50% and find a safe passage.
Find haven: Immediately turn to the nearest known port.

title: Distress Signal
description: There is some debris floating on the sea in the distance, and several survivors are waving desperately to you for help. They look exhausted.

choices.label: Immediate rescue: Lower the lifeboat and take in survivors.
Salvage debris: Only collect floating supplies, ignore calls for help.
Cold refusal: Maintain course, don't mind others' business.

title: Reef Grounding
description: With a dull thud, the ship's bottom vibrates violently. Oh no, we've hit an uncharted reef!

choices.label: Force off: Try to dash out of the reef area.
Wait for tide: Wait in place for the water level to rise and escape safely.

title: Merchant Encounter
description: On the mirror-like sea, a merchant ship flying a neutral flag is slowly approaching. They sent flag signals, seemingly wanting to exchange some supplies.

choices.label: Stop for trade: Enter a temporary trading interface.
Polite refusal: Continue sailing without wasting time.
Forceful raid: Enter combat and plunder supplies (Dangerous!).

title: Tailwind
description: A strong and steady trade wind blows from the stern, filling the sails. This is a great opportunity to speed up!

title: Headwind
description: The wind direction suddenly shifts to a headwind, and it's quite strong. Sailing becomes difficult, and speed drops significantly.
